heroCommands.command:
git clone https://github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.1.git
cd Wan2.1
pip install -r requirements.txt

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Wan2.1 is an open suite of video generation models from the Wan team. It creates videos from text or images, edits videos, makes images and can add audio, and it is the first video model in its README to generate readable Chinese and English text in videos.
sixtySeconds.problem: Most strong video models need data-centre GPUs or are closed. Wan2.1's 1.3B text-to-video model needs about 8 GB of GPU memory, so you can generate 480p clips on a consumer graphics card.
whoFor: Creators with a consumer NVIDIA GPU
Researchers building on open video models
Developers adding video generation to apps
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for open weights that run on consumer GPUs (1.3B) up to high-quality 14B models, with integrations in ComfyUI and Diffusers and a large ecosystem of community projects.
requirements: NVIDIA GPU (about 8.19 GB VRAM for the 1.3B model)

overview: Models include text-to-video at 1.3B and 14B, image-to-video at 14B in 480P and 720P versions, first-last-frame-to-video (FLF2V) and VACE for all-in-one creation and editing. Weights are on Hugging Face and ModelScope.

Clone the repository, install requirements, download a model and run generate.py with a task, size, checkpoint folder and prompt. The README says the 1.3B model makes a 5-second 480P video on an RTX 4090 in about 4 minutes without extra optimisation; --offload_model True and --t5_cpu reduce memory use.
Wan2.1 is also integrated into ComfyUI and Diffusers. The 1.3B model can do 720P but is less stable there, and FLF2V works best with Chinese prompts. It is Apache 2.0 licensed.

install.verificationNote: Commands come from Wan2.1's README. AIRepoHub hasn't run them yet.

steps.title: Install dependencies
steps.body: Make sure torch is 2.4.0 or newer.

firstRun.title: Generate a 480P video on a single consumer GPU
firstRun.code: python generate.py --task t2v-1.3B --size 832*480 --ckpt_dir ./Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B --offload_model True --t5_cpu --sample_shift 8 --sample_guide_scale 6 --prompt "Two anthropomorphic cats in comfy boxing gear and bright gloves fight intensely on a spotlighted stage."

tutorial.title: Make a 5-second video on a home GPU
tutorial.useCase: Download the 1.3B model and generate a 480P clip.
setup: NVIDIA GPU with about 8 GB VRAM

steps.title: Run generation with memory-saving options
steps.code: python generate.py --task t2v-1.3B --size 832*480 --ckpt_dir ./Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B --offload_model True --t5_cpu --sample_shift 8 --sample_guide_scale 6 --prompt "Two anthropomorphic cats in comfy boxing gear and bright gloves fight intensely on a spotlighted stage."

steps.title: Try your own prompt
steps.body: Change the --prompt text and run again.

tutorial.expected: A 5-second 480P video is saved; on an RTX 4090 this takes about 4 minutes according to the README.
